entries.description: ASPEED d8/d6 interface: pending stateful adapter
entries.constraints: Monitoring only. X570D4U firmware 1.35 uses raw duty 15..63 and requires reading current duty and limiting each change to 8 raw units. Stateless percentage templates cannot safely express this; no write commands shipped. Other ASRock firmware differs.

entries.description: AST2600 percentage interface documented in TSDQA-72
entries.constraints: Select explicitly only after verifying the controller is an ASRock Rack AST2600 with the documented 0xd0 interface. Whole-system 16-slot control; no BMCForge hardware verification. Not compatible with AST2500 or older 0x3a/0x01 boards.

entries.description: PowerEdge iDRAC 6/7/8 OEM whole-system fan duty
entries.constraints: Community-documented OEM commands; no BMCForge hardware verification. Excludes R210 II due to reported different behavior. Firmware must be checked on the actual device.

entries.description: PowerEdge 14G with legacy iDRAC9 firmware only
entries.constraints: Known firmware restrictions from 3.34 onward; exact compatibility must be verified. Newer generations are monitoring-only by default.
Monitoring only. IPMI support does not imply OEM fan control support.

entries.description: ATEN BMC X10-X13/H10-H13 two-zone duty control
entries.constraints: Select explicitly after checking the board and BMC. Not universal across X10-X13; X10QBi and newer OpenBMC stacks need different adapters. Auto restore selects Standard mode.

entries.description: Selected X9 ATEN boards, four zones, 0-255 scaling
entries.constraints: Only some X9 boards support this sequence; select explicitly after verifying the exact board. Standard mode used on restore.
